answer_1.quote: Open-ended text generation tasks involve generating coherent and fluent output with limited input information. These tasks encompass various applications such as chit-chat dialog, story generation, and similar domains.
answer_1.outputs: generated text in open-ended generation tasks such as dialog and story generation

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the quality of our generated texts using various automatic metrics, including diversity, MAUVE, coherence, greedy ratio, and gen-length.

answer_3.quote: We employ the large language model text-davinci-003 to overcome these limitations as an evaluator surrogate.

answer_4.quote: We randomly selected 50 samples from the test set and applied various decoding algorithms to generate sentences from them. For evaluation, we engaged two English language experts.
answer_4.guideline: The experts should assess and select superior sentences based on three criteria: consistency, fluency, and informativeness.
